ring: Use case: stylized-concept. Production background for Punch Tap!, portrait 9:16 mobile cartoon boxing game. Use the reference ONLY for hand-inked cartoon style and teal/orange/cream palette, no fighters drawn. Create beautiful polished cel-painted cozy rooftop boxing arena at blue-hour sunset, lively city skyline, warm string lights, small distant male audience behind back ropes. Very strong bold ink contours, simple cel-shaded painted surfaces, warm amber rim light, no photorealism. Camera fixed directly facing the far side of the ring, slightly elevated, symmetric perspective, NOT isometric. Composition precise: upper 15 percent dark quiet sky for separate HUD overlay; back ropes at 29 percent image height; large clean teal canvas from 31 to 72 percent, with subtle round cream center emblem at 53 percent; corner posts near side edges, front apron at 72 percent; bottom 25 percent quiet deep navy padded ringside space for separate touch controls. Ring feels compact and intimate. Large empty center stage for later boxer sprites. No player characters, no referee, no UI, no buttons, no bars, no lettering, no words, no watermarks. Finished game environment, not concept sheet.
controls: Use case: stylized-concept. Production UI sprite atlas for Punch Tap!, matching reference's thick dark ink outlines, warm cel-shaded highlights, teal/mint and tangerine boxing palette. TRANSPARENT background. Exactly 8 isolated UI assets in a strict 4 columns by 2 rows equal-cell grid, no labels, NO WORDS OR LETTERS, no characters. Each asset centered wholly inside its cell, generous transparent gutters, no overlaps. Read left-to-right: top row 1 circular dark teal padded joystick base with 4 small cream directional arrowheads around edge, center empty; 2 separate large circular mint joystick thumb cap with stitched leather edge and soft bright upper highlight; 3 orange rounded circular PUNCH BUTTON bearing a large ivory boxing-glove silhouette facing inward right, dark outline, beveled leather rim; 4 mirrored matching orange rounded circular PUNCH BUTTON glove facing inward left. Bottom row 5 gold rounded circular SPECIAL button with chunky cream five-point star, energetic but clean; 6 long horizontal EMPTY HEALTH BAR FRAME, rounded capsule shape, charcoal empty interior, ivory/teal metal rim, brass end caps, roughly 4:1 aspect ratio centered within cell; 7 standalone coral heart icon with bold outline and warm cel highlights; 8 compact dark teal rounded circular PAUSE button with two ivory vertical bars. Unified professionally illustrated mobile game UI, tactile padded-leather shapes, very legible at small sizes, restrained highlights, no glossy plastic, no photo, no text, no watermark. Asset 6 must remain EMPTY to fill programmatically. All background including between icons fully transparent.
